summary: News Corporation filed an 8-K disclosing daily buyback updates provided to the Australian Securities Exchange under its $1 billion stock repurchase program covering Class A and Class B common stock. The filing reports routine transaction disclosures, not new terms. The repurchase program authorizes open-market acquisitions over time; no price per share, premium, or close date is specified. This is a capital return via ongoing issuer buybacks. Watch for cumulative repurchase volume and remaining authorization in future quarterly reports.
